candidate_boundary.scope_note: Followed explicit scientific-intervention/method/review leads observed in official titles and original raw abstracts; not an exhaustive fulltext AI4S audit of all78 noncandidate records.

method_checks.finding: 50名学生随机比较自我披露与非披露机器人；方法原文明示两组用GPT-4o API，且用模型按SISCO量表评估压力，AI直接形成心理测量与实验干预。
七周设计研究以Yi-Class分析教学视频支持20名师范生反思；Method/Material明确计算机视觉及语音语言处理生成报告，AI实际形成教育研究干预。
Study1的108名学生确实与AI模拟队友互动；方法原文说明所有组反馈由同一AI工具生成、只随机操纵来源标签，Study2另为322人情境实验。不误写成所有实验组各自使用不同AI/人类评分器。

negative_leads.finding: Multimodal interaction and epistemic network analysis alone do not establish trained AI; not added solely for multimodal keyword.
Cognitive graph label alone does not establish AI model; no title-only inclusion.
Broad educational leadership taxonomy mixes administrative adoption and governance; no automatic AI4S inclusion from AI in title.
Writing-aid/detector generic performance and false-positive study not automatically added on education context alone; no claim of exhaustive relevance adjudication.
